name: Mobile Release
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'config/**'
      - 'Gemfile*'
      - '.github/workflows/mobile-release.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'config/**'
      - 'Gemfile*'
      - '.github/workflows/mobile-release.yml'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:13
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: sure_test
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.0.4
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
          npm ci

      - name: Database setup
        run: |
          bin/rails db:create
          bin/rails db:schema:load
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test

      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bin/rubocop

      - name: Run tests
        run: bin/rails test
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          file: ./coverage/.resultset.json
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

  build:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.0.4
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Build assets
        run: |
          bundle exec rake assets:precompile
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: production
          SECRET_KEY_BASE: dummykeyforbuild

      - name: Archive build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: mobile-build
          path: |
            public/assets
            Gemfile.lock
            package-lock.json
            vendor/bundle

  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.0.4
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: mobile-build
          path: .

      - name: Deploy to production
        run: |
          echo "Deploying to production environment"
          # Add your deployment commands here
        env:
          DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
          RAILS_ENV: production
